headline: Jay‑Z broke down his perspective on the beef between Biggie and 2Pac, saying their issues
body: Jay‑Z broke down his perspective on the beef between Biggie and 2Pac, saying their issues started long before the East vs. West explosion. He explained that as Pac’s career took off, he began surrounding himself with people Biggie didn’t trust. Biggie tried to warn him — but Pac reportedly took that warning straight back to the same people Biggie was worried about.

source_caption_text:
Jay‑Z broke down his perspective on the beef between Biggie and 2Pac, saying their issues started long before the East vs. West explosion.

He explained that as Pac’s career took off, he began surrounding himself with people Biggie didn’t trust. Biggie tried to warn him — but Pac reportedly took that warning straight back to the same people Biggie was worried about.

Jay‑Z added that these two were close friends before everything spiraled, and that an entire coast jumped in after their personal disagreement.

Fans say this moment sheds new light on how things really escalated 👀🔥
